defects.description: Rollback only re-imports new Ghost signups into MailPoet, so unsubscribes, bounces, complaints and paid/Stripe state recorded in Ghost after cutover are never carried back, and re-enabling MailPoet could re-mail opted-out readers and desync membership.
defects.evidence: rollback = repoint DNS and re-enable MailPoet sending, with any new Ghost signups exported and re-imported to MailPoet.
